blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate will tackle with the Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (Tesda) the P5-million “allocation fund” that the agency allegedly offered to Sen. Panfilo Lacson. “We’ll clarify it with Tesda during budget deliberation,” Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian said on Sunday in an interview with dzBB. Lacson, in a series of posts on X on Saturday, said he had “declined unequivocally” the allotment offer made to me through my Senate staff.” Tesda Director General Jose Francisco “Kiko” Benitez denied authorizing such an allocation for the senator and said his agency is now investigating that matter.
